rulings:
Joel, 2026-09-29: "the logic should be grounded in the meaning the reader needs to understand".
Joel, 2026-09-30 04:44, on scope: "in general we should assume the user doesn't want to massively increase the article size, but small increases or decreases may be fine if warranted. for any uncertainty ask the user."
Joel, 2026-10-01 (E93): his extreme examples explain his point; carry the reader's common case, and never poke readers to wonder whether they're the bad one.
The article's own words for the inside of a person are "part of you", "your little one", "the grown-up"/"the adult", "the Protector" and "the inherited critic voice".
Joel's standing rules: never call the inner child "the kid"; invent no facts about his life; banned: "doesn't get to decide" and its family, "Fine,"/"Good,"/"Great," as a clause, wry humor. No emojis from the writers.
Joel, 2026-10-01 20:51, on Make a Simple Vow P3: "So it's not like we are accusing people of lying about loving their inner child, but they might be faking it til they make it. ... I don't think faking love is a good idea because that's not an action that speaks for itself, it's a feeling that we have to trust is there." Acts can be practiced before they feel natural; love is felt. Never word a condition as a question of the reader's sincerity.
Joel, 2026-10-01 20:51, on P5: "it sounds too biased towards adulting"; "If they show up to have some innocent fun, don't \"put them in their place\" as the adult." The article already has: "If the only time the Nurturer shows up is when something's wrong, your little one can start to feel like they're your job."
Joel, 2026-10-02 00:16 and 01:08, on pointing back: "you put in a referent to something sections ago nobody will remember"; "it's not that a ref back has to say what it means, but it depends how far back it's referring to. nobody will remember something sections away. If it's from the last paragraph and it's clearly referring then it may be fine." Nothing may lean on something from sections back; every sentence has to work for a reader who doesn't remember it.
Joel, 2026-10-02 00:16, on the guide's caution that a comfort object isn't an oracle: "I don't think people will be confusing the stuffed animal with an oracle." A caution the reader doesn't need gets cut, not replaced with a vaguer one.
Joel, 2026-10-02 00:16, on the guide's small acts ("keeping an appointment, eating, or going to bed"): "that sounds almost ridiculous". An example has to show what its sentence says it shows, for the common reader.
What the guide says Joel or the people in his life did, said, felt or thought is INVENTED unless his own words say it (Joel, 2026-10-01, on a detail the guide added to his bedtime story: "not what happened (i mean it's true she didn't, altho maybe she did, you don't know)").

after:
My friend Scott said:

> "Half the time when I try to connect to baby me, I feel fake and it seems crazy."
brief:
- the first paragraph under the new heading "When the Adult Voice Feels Fake"
- what it says: a lot of people get stuck right here. You call up the Nurturer and try to talk to your little one, and you get nothing back: silence, or numbness, or a voice saying this is silly. And all of a sudden your phone, dinner, or some small chore around the house feels urgent.
- The article already has, in The Chicken-and-Egg Problem: "it's like you sit there trying to be loving while your mind is becoming controlled again by the inherited critic voice, or you start going numb, throwing a fit, or panicking." Don't repeat that, and don't point back to it.
- The next paragraph introduces Joel's friend Scott's quote ("My friend Scott said:"), so end in a way the quote can follow.
length: two to four sentences, 50 to 80 words
guide_passage: This is where many people get stuck. You activate the Nurturer, try to speak to the inner child, and get silence. Or numbness. Or a voice saying, “This is so silly.” Suddenly the phone needs checking, dinner needs planning, and a minor household task becomes emotionally urgent.
next: My friend Scott said: “Half the time when I try to connect to baby me, I feel fake and it seems crazy.”
cut: Let them come and go without making them responsible for the session.
